answer:
Cristiano Ronaldo dos Santos Aveiro (born February 5, 1985) is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a forward and is widely recognized as one of the most successful players in football history [SRC-83c65cc45d4b].

### Career Milestones
- **Club Career:** He began his professional career at Sporting CP in 2002 before moving on to Manchester United, Real Madrid (where he became the all-time leading goalscorer with 450 goals in 438 appearances), Juventus, and Saudi Arabian club Al Nassr, with a contract running through 2027 [SRC-83c65cc45d4b].
- **International Career:** He captains the Portugal national team, winning the UEFA European Championship in 2016 and UEFA Nations League titles in 2019 and 2025 [SRC-83c65cc45d4b].

### Major Achievements
- **Individual Awards:** Secured five Ballon d'Or titles [SRC-83c65cc45d4b].
- **Club Honors:** Secured five UEFA Champions League titles alongside multiple domestic honors [SRC-83c65cc45d4b].

Key Takeaways
Ronaldo started his professional career at Sporting CP before joining Manchester United in 2003.
He became Real Madrid’s all-time leading goalscorer with 450 goals in 438 La Liga appearances.
He has won five Ballon d’Or awards and five Champions League titles.
Portugal won Euro 2016 and the UEFA Nations League in 2019 and 2025 with Ronaldo.
In 2026, he became the first male player to score in six different FIFA World Cups.
He helped Al Nassr win the 2025–26 Saudi Pro League title.
He remains an active professional player and has publicly discussed reaching 1,000 career goals before retirement.
Who Is Cristiano Ronaldo?
Cristiano Ronaldo is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays for Saudi Arabian club Al Nassr. He is widely regarded as one of the greatest goalscorers in football history.
Ronaldo became famous for his speed, dribbling, finishing, physical fitness, and ability to score important goals. His success across England, Spain, Italy, Saudi Arabia, and international football makes his career unusual.
At Manchester United, he developed into a world-class winger. At Real Madrid, he became one of the most consistent goalscorers in European football. At Juventus, he continued scoring regularly in Serie A.
Later, his move to Al Nassr brought him to Saudi Arabia, where he continued playing into his forties.
